description: Social listening with Rumoro. Follow what people say about your brand, competitors and topics on Reddit, X, Hacker News, GitHub, Bluesky and more. Search and sort scored mentions, send them to Slack, Telegram, email or a webhook, and see trends and who is posting. Use it when the user asks what people say about their product or a competitor, or mentions Rumoro.
